podcast.body: This song by Joy Division serves as the epitaph on Ian Curtis's gravesite. He died by suicide on May 18, 1980. "And the title of that song serves as the epitaph on his gravesite."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song title serves as the epitaph on Ian Curtis's gravesite, reflecting the personal turmoil he experienced, including an impending divorce and an affair. "And the title of that song serves as the epitaph on his gravesite. Love will terror-suppart."
